name: Precious Peas
summary: Hard little spheres that arrive separately and refuse to be introduced.
note: Dry, round, and strangely polite. They bounce off each other in the bowl like they have dinner plans.

name: Pebble Beach
summary: A whole shoreline, built slowly and without water.
note: Not one stone. A weekend's worth. Every pebble has a crack in it and an alibi.

name: The Porcupine
summary: Precious peas that grew spines on the way out.
note: Same family as the peas. Worse exit interview. You will remember the shape longer than the name.

name: Cracked Pavement
summary: A log that dried in the sun before it ever saw the sun.
note: Sausage-shaped, lumpy, and split into plates. One more glass of water and this would have been a different animal.

name: The Corkscrew
summary: Someone threaded it on a lathe.
note: A continuous ridge runs the length of it. Cracks on the high points. It looks engineered, which is not a comfort.

name: The Trophy Log
summary: Smooth, complete, and it sank with dignity.
note: The field guide's cover model. You look back. You are allowed to be proud. You should not text anyone.

name: Snake in the Grass
summary: Long, smooth, and coiled like it meant to stay.
note: One piece, no cracks, a lazy S in the water. The composition is honestly pretty good.

name: The Birthday Candle
summary: Narrow, upright, and waiting for a wish you will not make.
note: Taller than it is wide, standing in the water on one end. Blow it out only in the metaphorical sense.

name: Soft Serve
summary: Soft blobs with edges, swirled to a peak that held.
note: Clear-cut pieces, glossy, still a shape. It peaked. You may not photograph it. The field guide already did.

name: Confetti
summary: Fluffy ragged bits. A celebration nobody put on the calendar.
note: Mushy edges, several pieces, no single hero. Flush twice. Then look anyway.

name: The Mudslide
summary: Not a squirt. A landslide with a schedule.
note: Thick, slow, and it paints a stripe on the way down. The bowl learns the route.

name: Hershey Squirts
summary: No warning, no structure, a chocolate emergency.
note: Watery, sudden, and already on the underside of the seat in spirit if not in fact. Hydrate. Then apologize to the room.

name: The Oil Slick
summary: A thin pool with a film that catches the bathroom light.
note: Almost no body, just a greasy sheen. Do not light a match. Do not describe the colors out loud.

name: The Unsinkable
summary: It finished the job and then refused to leave.
note: Buoyant. Smug. High in the water like a duck that knows your Wi-Fi password. The flush is a suggestion.

name: The Drowned Sub
summary: Dense, dark, and gone before you stood up.
note: It sank with purpose. You hear the tap on the porcelain. By the time you look, it has a new zip code.

name: Ghost Poop
summary: You went. You wiped. Nothing was there.
note: The paper came back clean. The water is unmarked. Something left, and it took the evidence with it. You do not trust this. You are right not to.

name: The Cling-On
summary: It met the bowl and signed a lease.
note: Above the waterline. Unmoved by the first flush. The second flush is a negotiation. Bring a brush and a sense of proportion.

name: The Corn Curse
summary: Everything else was digested. The corn was not.
note: Whole kernels, bright as they were on the plate, embedded like tiles. The corn attended. The corn will be in the sequel.

name: Chocolate Thunder
summary: You heard it before you finished sitting down.
note: A single impact with a soundtrack. The room needs a minute. So do you. Open a window before you open the door.

name: The Aftershock
summary: You stood up. You sat back down. The meeting was not adjourned.
note: The first one was a complete sentence. The second one was the footnote you had already walked away from. Wash your hands again.
